sloka: तद् वृत्तम् नृपतिः श्रुत्वा दूत श्रेष्ठैः महा जवैः ।आज्ञया तु नरेन्द्रस्य आजगाम कुशध्वजः ॥१-७०-८॥
transliteration: tad vṛttam nṛpatiḥ śrutvā dūta śreṣṭhaiḥ mahā javaiḥ ।ājñayā tu narendrasya ājagāma kuśadhvajaḥ ॥1-70-8॥

translations.english: Kusadhwaja having heard the events from the loyal, mighty messengers set out for Mithila in compliance with the request of the king (Janaka).
